readerCopy.body: A comeback offer can be flattering and materially useful while pointing toward a role that is already well understood. When the Sun opposes the North Node, familiar recognition and forward movement face each other directly, making an old title, audience, or area of expertise attractive because credibility already exists there. Money, access, and influence can make the old strength worth using. The opportunity becomes limiting when the reward only leaves less room to develop what is newer.
